issues.description: Distillation-circuit builder function name is inconsistent: the problem statement (and referenced test name test_build_msd_circ) requires `build_msd_circ(...)`, but the template provides the stub as `build_msd_circuit(...)`. This mismatch can cause students to implement the template stub but fail autograder tests expecting `build_msd_circ`.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template stub `build_msd_circuit` to `build_msd_circ` to match the problem statement/tests. Optionally keep `build_msd_circuit` as a backward-compatible wrapper that calls `build_msd_circ`.

issues.description: Template docstring for the distillation-circuit builder describes the second returned list as "final X-basis measurements of the distilled state", but the problem statement specifies the second list must be the measurement indices of the destructive X-basis measurements of the 15 tetrahedral-code qubits (in code-qubit order). This can mislead students into returning the wrong measurement indices/order.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template docstring to match the spec: return (1) teleportation measurement indices and (2) destructive X-basis measurement indices of the 15 tetrahedral-code qubits in qubit order.
